title: Auto-grid fit-content row track floor must follow the fit min height, not the row height
answers: auto grid panel has empty space / bottom padding below it when content fit is on
fit content panel shrinks but row still reserves 320px
why is there dead space between a short panel and the next row in auto grid layout
how is autoRows computed for AutoGridLayout with min height
body:
Symptom: In an auto-grid dashboard with fit-content and a min height below the row height (e.g. custom 100px or 'short'), a short panel shrinks but the next row starts ~row-height below it, leaving dead space.
Root cause: AutoGridLayoutManager.tsx:getAutoRowsTemplate always used the row height as the CSS grid track floor (`minmax(rowHeightPx, max-content)`), so the shared grid row reserved the full row height even when the panel was shorter.
Fix pattern: When fit content is present and fill screen is off, floor the track at `Math.min(rowHeightPx, getFitMinHeightInPixels(minHeight, rowHeight))` ('none' -> 0px, 'tall' clamped to row height). Without fit content the template is unchanged (`minmax(320px, 320px)` / `minmax(320px, auto)` for fill screen).
Constraints: Every caller must pass minHeight: AutoGridLayoutManager constructor, AutoGridLayoutManager.updateAutoRows (now also called from onMinHeightChanged), and AutoGridLayoutSerializer.ts:deserializeAutoGridLayout (minHeightCombined). Missing one makes the floor stale after load or after editing min height. Only applies when the GrafanaDashboardsAutoHeightPanels flag is on.
applies: Dashboard scene auto-grid layout row sizing (autoRows) with content-fit / auto-height panels
